apps.name: Off-site Backup
apps.summary: Copies each new encrypted server backup to S3-compatible storage within 15 minutes, and can start a backup now.

apps.name: Website Monitor
apps.summary: Checks your websites on a schedule and alerts you by email or webhook when one is down or its certificate is about to expire.

apps.name: Server Console
apps.summary: A dashboard for your Automaton server: CPU, memory, disk, OS updates, restart status, versions, certificates and backups, with 24 hours of history and email and webhook warnings.

apps.name: Heartbeat
apps.summary: Gives each of your jobs a check-in URL and alerts you by email or webhook when a check-in is missed.

apps.name: IT-Tools
apps.summary: Handy online tools for developers: converters, encoders, generators and formatters. Runs entirely in the browser.

apps.name: GoatCounter
apps.summary: Privacy-friendly web analytics: easy to use, no cookies, no tracking of visitors.

apps.name: linkding
apps.summary: Save, tag and search bookmarks on your own server.

apps.name: Harbour Wallpaper
apps.summary: A living harbour island for your desktop that reacts to clicks: the sea, the sheep, the boats and the church bell.
